instruction: R2 SAFETY-lens review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020H.3.1 at commit 63ba1ea (post fix-round-1 + self-correction). Prior R1 safety found 1 MAJ + 3 MIN + 1 nit. All closed in fix-round-1: job split for SAFE-MAJ-001; D-037 ratification for SAFE-MIN-003; tr-cd sanitisation for SAFE-MIN-001; gh label create --force for SAFE-MIN-002; Python templating in both branches for SAFE-nit-001. VERIFY adversarially: (1) Job split closure: release-gate.yml now has TWO jobs. release-gate has contents:read only; release-gate-violation-issue has contents:read + issues:write. The release-gate-violation-issue job's if condition uses needs.release-gate.result == failure AND github.event_name == push. Adversarially trace: (a) could the issue-opener fire on workflow_dispatch dry-runs? push-only check blocks. (b) Could release-gate accidentally include issues:write via implicit GITHUB_TOKEN scope? Workflow-default contents:read means GITHUB_TOKEN has contents:read only by default; issues:write granted ONLY to second job. Verified clean. (c) Does the new job have access to release-gate evaluation logic? No, needs creates one-way data dep; second job runs in fresh runner. Sound. (2) D-037 ratification: row text claims symmetric with D-029. Verify D-029 row in DECISIONS.md actually documents statuses:write expansion plus threat surface. Verify D-037 names precise threat-surface (gh issue create / comment / label create) AND bounded behaviour (same-repo only). (3) Tag sanitisation closure: tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9._-'. GITHUB_REF is GitHub-controlled not user-controlled; sanitisation is defense-in-depth. (4) Label pre-create closure: gh label create --force is idempotent. Could attacker abuse this? --force overwrites colour/description; CODEOWNERS gates the workflow file. Acceptable. (5) Python templating both branches: comment-body branch uses python3 heredoc with f-string. f-strings only interpret braces, no shell-injection surface. Sound. (6) Search query closure: substring search + jq exact-title filter. Could substring match a tag-name that's substring of another (e.g. v1.0.0 matches v1.0.0-rc.1)? jq exact-match filter avoids the false positive. Sound. (7) New attack surfaces from fix-round-1: (a) label pre-create runs BEFORE issue-create; both CODEOWNERS-gated. (b) CANDIDATE_TAG_RESOLVED export at commit 63ba1ea; export uses already-sanitised tag. Sound. (8) Re-read every R1 safety finding (review-safety.json) and verify each closure is genuine. (9) Cross-document consistency: workflow + DISPATCH-NOTE + FIX-ROUND-1.md + STATUS.md + DECISIONS.md D-037 all describe the privilege-scope refactor. Per WP-SCP-022 4.3. Return SonnetReviewResult JSON. NEVER recommend descoping. Fixpoint criterion: zero new CRIT or MAJ findings.
